meta.name: run-train
meta.description: Rigor Train skill for deep learning research repositories. Use when a documented or selected training command should be run conservatively for startup verification, short-run verification, full kickoff, or resume, with command, config, seed, log, checkpoint, status, and metric evidence written to standardized `train_outputs/`. Do not use for environment setup, exploratory sweeps, speculative idea implementation, or end-to-end orchestration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 运行深度学习训练并输出标准记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想严谨地启动或恢复深度学习训练并留下标准记录
copy.tagline_en: Run deep learning training with standardized evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to launch or resume deep learning training with standardized evidence

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按你选定的训练命令保守地执行训练,并把命令、配置、随机种子、日志、检查点、状态和指标等证据写入 `train_outputs/` 下的标准文件。它只负责跑训练并记录,不会自行决定研究目标或做探索性改造。
howto.when: 当你已选定训练命令,并要求做启动验证、短跑验证、完整启动等运行时触发;不做环境搭建、仅推理/评估或探索性试验。

say.text: 请用启动验证模式跑这个训练命令。
say.note: 它会保守执行并写入 train_outputs。

say.text: 帮我做一次短跑验证,记录到 train_outputs。
say.note: 输出日志、检查点和指标等标准文件。

say.text: 从上次检查点恢复训练,并刷新状态文件。
say.note: 会记录恢复状态并续写训练日志。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs the selected training command conservatively and writes evidence—command, config, seed, logs, checkpoints, status, metrics—into standardized files under train_outputs/. It only executes and records training; it does not set research goals or make exploratory changes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you have a chosen training command and ask for startup verification, short-run verification, full kickoff, or resume. Not used for environment setup, inference/evaluation only, or speculative exploration.

say_en.text: Run the selected training command in startup verification mode.
say_en.note: It executes conservatively and writes train_outputs records.

say_en.text: Do a short-run verification and write logs and metrics to train_outputs.
Resume training from the checkpoint and update status files.
say_en.note: Records resumed state and continues logs.
